title: Ultimatebeat: Too Much to Lose
description: The story of one online poker site that defrauded its customers for years. When caught, nobody is arrested, indicted or convicted and the fraudsters paid back far less than they stole.

title: Instructions on Parting
description: The documentary film 'Instructions on Parting,' is an intimate portrait of love and loss that observes family and nature undergoing the cycle of birth to death.

title: Shanthi Nilayam
description: The story revolves around a well known hospital called Shanthi Nilayam and the doctors working in it. The problems surrounding the personal lives of the doctors and the hardships faced by them at the workplace are portrayed very well with different narration.

title: Vasantham Vanthachu
description: Kumaresan (Venkat Prabhu) is a milk vendor in his village, who hates the marriage and stays away from women. His elderly father (Velu Thigal) wants him to get married as soon as possible, but the Kumaresan stubbornly refuses to get married. During the college holidays, the city girl Gayathri (Nanditha Jennifer) comes to stay with her grandparents Chettiar (Shanmugasundaram) and Meenakshi (Varalakshmi). After initial clashes between Kumaresan and Gayathri, Gayathri is intrigued by its refusal to get married. In the past, Kumaresan's brother got secretly married to a woman from a rich family. Kumaresan's family welcomed him and were happy for them. The young Kumaresan clashed with his sister-in-law, therefore the young couple left their home. Kumaresan fell sick after the departure of the couple, then Kumaresan and his father begged Kumaresan's brother to call on their mother (Sabitha Anand) but his sister-in-law refused to let him go. Before she died, Kumaresan's mother Chellamma asked Kumaresan to not be like his brother and to stay with his father. That day, Kumaresan took the decision of remaining single. Meanwhile, Gayathri falls in love with Kumaresan. Gayathri then tied the mangala sutra to herself and lied to the villagers that Kumaresan is the one who tied the knot. Gayathri's grandparents and Kumaresan's father agree for their marriage. Kumaresan doesn't want to live with her, so he tries several ways to drive Gayathri out of his house. Afterwards, the village doctor Rajasekhar (Ramji), who knows about the matter, establishes the truth at the village court and the couple split up. Gayathri then goes to back to her parents. Kumaresan, who felt alone, realises that he was in love with Gayathri but it was too late. The film ends with Gayathri returning to his home and they immediately get married.

title: Once Upon a Small Town
description: A city veterinarian moves to the countryside where he meets a policewoman, a town insider with a friendly secret.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

title: 40M²
description: A portrait of life during the pandemic made by those who live in the poorest neighborhoods of São Paulo. Two hundred short films united to form four thematic episodes.

title: I'm with Me
description: Days before Valentine's day and their wedding, Cindy Hunter, editor-in-chief of a tabloid and Damon Tuckland, a successful therapist encounter a strange plant that magically puts Cindy's mind in Damon's body and vice versa. Now the couple really finds out how the other half lives. In a series of comic mishaps at work, with relatives and at home, Cindy and Damon must become better people and figure out a way to reverse the "awkward" situation before their wedding or face a lifetime as each other. It's the ultimate body-swapping comedy with a heart that gives a brand-new meaning to the term "The Opposite Sex".

title: Giati m' egateleipses
description: Under the pretence of creating a better future for his impecunious wife and his son, an insensitive father cruelly abandons them in high hopes of striking it rich. Will he find the strength to admit his grave mistake, and return to them?

title: Hippocampus M 21th
description: The word "Hippocampus" was inspired by the hippocampus, a part of the brain located in the temporal lobe, which plays a key role in the learning process and in the formation of new memories about events lived. It is the hippocampus, which connects all the different parts of an experience to form an episodic memory. The letter M is a tribute to "M - The Monster of Dusseldorf" the film by Fritz Lang inspired crimes committed in Germany in the Twenties. The number "21th" references the period in which the film is set, the twenty-first century: the monsters of today. Apartment 37413 Once a week three crazy brothers meet to relive their childhood disorder eating human raw organs and living a sadomasochistic rapport/intercourse... Apartment 28513 The torture of Barbie. A man enjoys torturing and scarring Barbie, but one day he'll decide to do it with real women... Apartment 13396 A painter uses his blood and his muse's faces to prepare the perfect colors for his masterpiece... Apartment 1932301 A woman is looking for a way to becomes excited and she'll discover it touching/with the contact of insects and cockroaches... Apartment 121197 A self-destructive necromancer conserves the mummified corpse of his husband and every night she has sex with it... Apartment 7428M An erotomaniac obsessed by a clown who is in his house blowing up balloons and exploding it.

title: Mama/M.A.M.A.
description: From the Academy Award[TM]-nominated and Emmy Award[TM]-winning producer of "Waco: The Rules of Engagement" and the Academy Award[TM]-nominated writer/director of "Death on the Job" comes "Mama/M.A.M.A.: Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy." "Mama/M.A.M.A." is the provocative investigation of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy, a perplexing psychological disorder where a mother secretly but deliberately harms her child in order to get the sympathy and praise of others and the attention of the medical community. What emerges over three years of scrutiny are disturbing questions related to the medical profession's arrogant use of the diagnosis, the possible contribution from the pharmaceutical industry, and its grievous impact on families. Questions addressed in this film include: Is this syndrome an authentic phenomenon or is it a witch hunt? What are the moral implications of a society that fails to question the science behind the disorder, blindly lending faith to its sensational existence? The deeply disturbing "Mama/M.A.M.A." closely follows three cases, allowing the audience to absorb all points of view and determine who the real abusers are. (Florida Film Festival)

title: Heidi M.
description: A dramatic movie about feelings, desires and illusions.

title: I'm Sorry
description: A seemingly-confident comedy writer, wife and mom comically exposes her inner immaturity and neuroses through unexpected life situations.

title: Strange M. Victor
description: A merchant from Toulon (Raimu) of honorable appearance is in fact a receiver for a band of criminals. Threatened with blackmail, he commits a murder for which an innocent man is condemned to the penal colony (Pierre Blanchar). Eight years later, the convict escapes and our trader collects it.

title: Generation Wolf
description: Generation Wolf talks about a young entrepreneur who is about to lose his business and choose to grow marijuana as an easy way to save it. But soon enough he realizes that crossing the line could have extreme consequences into his life.

title: M.L.A. Fatakesto
description: A small time goon becomes a member of the legislative assembly; the story depicts a week in his life.

title: I'm Not Gay
description: A comedic short film about two guys refusing to confess their sexual attraction towards each other.

title: S & M: Les Sadiques
description: Marie, a teenage vagabond whose lust for life will eventually lead her to the bed of the mysterious Sandra. What begins as a blissful relationship soon takes a violent turn however, as Sandra tries to take full control over the innocent girl's life.

title: The Mysterious Mr. M
description: An evil scientist known as "Mr. M." uses a drug he has developed called "hypnotreme" to help steal submarine equipment. Federal agent Grant Farrell is dispatched to find the mysterious villain and stop his nefarious plans.

title: Rocketship X-M
description: An astronaut crew on their way to the Moon are unexpectedly propelled by gravitational forces and end up on Mars instead.

title: M Cream [Hindi]
description: A motley crew of university students set out on a journey in pursuit of a mythical form of hash, confronting a series of encounters that begin to unravel the myriad realities of rebellion.

title: Lilian M.: Relatório Confidencial
description: Maria, a countrywoman, leaves for São Paulo, where she becomes an industrialist's lover and meets all kind of people but, dissatisfied, she returns to the country to meet her family again.

title: Rhys Darby: I'm a Fighter Jet
description: Rhys Darby regales the crowd with anecdotes about his time in the military, his affinity for mushroom shakes, his wife's inability to communicate effectively and more.

title: I'm Haunted 2
description: A woman who watched the Genesis Brady videos from the first I'm Haunted movie attempts to summon the same entity herself to determine whether or not it was a hoax.

title: Neal 'n' Nikki
description: Take a joyride with Neal and Nikki as they travel all across Canada to find what they want most. And it's going to be quite a trip.

title: N/949
description: A drug-abuse tragedy affected to Marco, Luka's best friend. Luka felt guilty about that. That's why he decided to begin an outsider lifestyle in a society where nobody can breath.

title: Rock 'n' Roll
description: Passionate rock'n roll dancer, Rodolfo has his partner Ornella as a partner. Frozen by the frivolous behavior of the boy, however, the young girl no longer wants to learn to dance with him.

title: Kit N Sam
description: Sam and Kit have been a faithful couple going-steady for two years. They get engaged. About a week before their marriage, Kit comes up with a proposition, which she thinks will keep their marriage a success forever. She tells Sam that till marriage they should go out and taste the forbidden fruit of infidelity, so that they don't have any desire for other men/women after marriage - after much hesitation, Sam agrees to her proposal A hilarious turn of events ensue through the misadventures of Kit and Sam as they go about trying to have affairs with other men and women - until they realize what true love is.

title: Lance N' Masques
description: Yotaro Hanafusa is a descendant of the "Knights of the World." With the Knight's Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as "Knight Lancer" but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

title: Beat n Path
description: This docu-series follows Lupe Fiasco, a Grammy award winning rapper from Chicago, as he drops everything to embark on a cross-cultural journey across China to live out his other passion - martial arts. Lupe also takes the opportunity to explore China's hip hop scene and record his next hit, Air China, a song inspired by his journey and experience.

description: A businessman who balances between legality and illegality can't persuade his rightful employee to overlook his financial discrepancies. To succeed, he enlists the help of a beautiful woman; however, what happens if she, too, fails?

title: Despertar: O Mundo o Espera
description: Há seis anos, o presidente da Associação Mundial de Neurologia recusou convites de instituições médicas de elite para se dedicar a uma única missão, garantir a recuperação de uma pessoa extraordinária. Durante esse período, essa figura permaneceu em um quarto de luxo, com sua condição envolta em mistério. Não se tratava de um paciente comum – seis anos atrás, essa pessoa havia mudado o curso da história. Agora, com o despertar iminente, o mundo está prestes a testemunhar o retorno de uma lenda, cujas ações prometem transformar a realidade e trazer mudanças sísmicas.

title: O Mallige
description: Mallige (Charulata) lives in a small village with her uncle (V.Manohar). A heart patient, Manohar has an ambitious wannabe model in his son Nacchi (Zulfi Syed) who is lost in the bliss of the big city. When he suffers another nearly fatal stroke, Nacchi reluctantly returns to be by his dying father's side. Seizing the opportunity, the dying man manages to knot the innocent village belle Mallige to our dear city chap. As much as Nacchi hates the decision, he goes along considering his father's health. He even manages to consummate the wedlock under the influence of alcohol. A few days later the old man dies leaving the helpless girl to his son. The very next day Nacchi leaves her who has nowhere to turn for support. Days roll by and soon Mallige realizes she is expecting a baby. To take things under her own control she decides to join her absconding husband in the city. Nachi changing his name as Naresh Patel has shifted base to city and is shown wooing the rich daughter (Chaitali) of a millionaire (Avinash) to fuel his aspirations of becoming a successful model. Soon the young couple is shown exchanging sweet nothings in parks and restaurants while the pregnant girl is roaming the streets of the city looking for her ignorant husband. Krishna Murthy alias Kitti (Ramesh) who is also an aspiring model in between odd jobs. An accident brings Kitti and Mallige together as she is seriously injured in the mishap and loses all memory of her immediate past. For his convenience to shoo off the prying landlords, Kitti brings Mallige to his house and christens her Lakshmi since she has no memory of her name. A special bond of affection starts forming between the two. Nacchi continues his Casanova ways with the rich girl unaware of any of these happenings. Lakshmi bears a child and names him Ganesha. Meanwhile, Kitti manages to get a plum offer from the same firm that works with Mallige's husband. Soon Nacchi as his girlfriend realizes that he is married and so starts encouraging Kitti instead to get back at him. Nacchi confronts her and ends up apologizing for his "mistake" but she is firm in her decision and decides not to have anything to do with him. Things start falling into place when she sees Mallige at Kitti's place and informs him about the truth. Kitti is heartbroken at the thought of losing Mallige to a stranger. title: O Banquete
description: End of the 80's, Brazil. Despite returning to democracy, the country is still experiencing extreme political instability and general uncertainty. title: O Fim e o Princípio
description: A film starting from naught. With no prior research, no characters, no sites, nor specific themes, a film team arrive to the hinterland of Paraíba state in northeastern Brazil in search of people with stories to tell. In the village of São João do Rio do Peixe they come to Sítio Araçás, a rural community of 86 families, mostly relatives. With a girl from Araçás as mediator, the residents, in their majority, elderly, tell their life story, marked by popular catholicism, by a hierarchy, by a sense of family and honor - in a world fast disappearing.

title: O prodotis

title: O Seminarista

Just before his ordination, he meets Margarida again, and their old feelings for each other are triggered once more.

title: O episkeptis

title: O Adeus que Sacudiu o Trono

Com a ascensão da nova imperatriz Rosalina, ela passa a confiar no bacharel corrupto Evaristo, querendo substituir Enzo. Enzo prometeu ao leito de morte do Imperador anterior que iria suportar Rosalina cem vezes, e só restam três agora. Após isso, pedirá demissão e se afastará para sempre.

title: P@St Forward
description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

title: Vice ayaw pabalikin si Bong Bong sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

description: A cultural snap-shot of America's underground, do-it-yourself music scene featuring unforgettable live performances from Matt and Kim, Dan Deacon, Mika Miko, The DeathSet and many more.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon?

title: Miss Q&A: Mga pamahiin sa pagsali sa pageants
description:
Sa dami ng nangyayari sa paligid, kailangan natin ng good news at good vibes para i-reset ang ating isip. Dito sa "It's Showtime," happiness overload ang mga eksenang mapapanood.

Isang pagbati ang ipinarating ng It's Showtime family sa 21-year-old world tennis champion na si Alex Eala, na gumawa ng kasaysayan sa mundo ng tennis matapos makuha ang kauna-unahang WTA title para sa Pilipinas nang talunin niya si world No. 3 Jessica Pegula ng United States sa 2026 Mubadala DC Open, na ginanap sa Washington D.C.

Mula sa isang alamat sa mundo ng sports, isang alamat sa larangan ng P-Pop din ang bumisita. Sinimulan ng P-Pop favorite Alamat ang episode with a performance of their track, "Sinigang," na inihain ng grupo specially for you!

Bawal ang nega, pero welcome dito si Negi, ang guest co-host of the day, na join sa pakikipagkulitan nina Jhong Hilario at Ogie Alcasid sa Miss Q&A candidates.

May pasok, as in pasok sa banga ang wit at pagrampa nina Miss Q&A Cheska Deyn, Leo Castillo, at Angelbert Castill. At pasok sa banga ang mga paandar nila't special skills. Sina Cheska at Angelbert ang umabante sa Round 2, Wit Lang, kung saan sagot nila'y sure na sure, showing grace under pressure.

Hindi suspended ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sumugod s rumaragasang god vibes at papremyo ang Madlang Players mula Pamplona, Las Pinas City.

Kapag 'Kim' ang pangalan, maganda talaga ang ngiti n'yan! Dahil sa magaan na awra ni player Kim, isang 21-year-old daddy, nag-enjoy ang hosts na makipagkuwentuhan sa kanya tungkol sa trabaho't pamilya.

Enjoy rin ang Madlang People sa libreng 'sine' sa FUNanghalian. Sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round, may horror at comedy, at may kilig hatid ng tambalang DaCKie!

title: Vhong at Ogie nagkapikunan sa mainit na puksaan
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

title: Vice, sinala ang TALENT ng mga Miss Q&A candidates
description:
Paligayahin muna ang mga puso sa good vibes na dala ng "It's Showtime" family, at chill jamming with "The Voice USA" champ Sofronio Vasquez, na bagay na bagay sa cuddle weather ang boses.

Kuwentuhan na lang tayo, biro ni Vice Ganda sa mga kaibigang sina Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario bago magsimula ang 'Miss Q and A.' Napa-reminisce ang trio sa mga kuwentong ulan at kuwentong baha nila noong kabataan.

Full of hope naman ang talak nina Miss Q and A candidates Namssie Lopez, Raine Garcia, at Eron Tuico Arganosa. Bago ang talakan, sa talent muna sila nagpasiklaban! Pati sina hurados Nicole Cordoves, Brent Manalo, at Karylle napilitang mag-sample ng talent!

Sina Namssie at Raine ang sumalang sa witty tanungan sa Wit Lang round. Para kay Namssie, "Alin ang mas pipiliin mo, pangit ang araw mo pero maganda ka, o maganda ang araw mo pero pangit ka?" Nabunot naman ni Raine ang tanong na, "Anong mas ikakaglit ng sinaing, 'yung nasunog siya o hindi na-on ang rice cooker?"

Dakila ang kanilang hanapbuhay bilang mga kasambahay. Kaya deserve nila ang mag-relax muna at magpahinga sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Makihula at maki-POT at Li-Pot kasama ang mga kasambahay ng San Pedro, Laguna.

Naantig si Vice sa kuwento ni player Wency, na sa pamamagitan ng paglalaba at pagsisilbi sa mga amo ay nakapagpatapos ng mga anak sa kolehiyo. Naramdaman ni Vice ang saya ng isang inang nakapagpa-graduate ng anak sa pamamagitan ng sariling pawis at sakripisyo.

Binigyan ni Vice ng tig-sampung libo ang bawat kasambahay na naglaro sa game arena. Naiyak ang isang player sa ayuda ni Vice dahil, aniya, saktong nangangailangan siya ng pera upang makalipat ng tirahan.

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na makakabalik sa game arena. Si Ocel ang biniyayaan ng universe ng second chance. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Malaking bagay na ito kay Ocel, kaya naman "Li-Pot" ang kanyang sigaw!

Isang eliminated player naman ang nakakuha ng P50,000 dahil sa ibinigay na pagkakataon ni Vice Ganda na sagutin ang POT question.

title: Kandidata, pinulikat sa gitna ng Miss Q&A weekly finals
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

title: Linda Walker natameme sa sagot ni Kelly sa Miss Q&A It's Showtime
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A Mentoy ibinahagi ang 'traumatic' experience
description:
Stay safe and stay dry, Madlang People! Kung malakas man ang buhos ng ulan, stay home muna as much as possible. "It's Showtime" and chill muna sabay sayaw ng moves na nakaka-"Oooh Lala!" Kaninong pambato ang panalo sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance for today's video?

With full energy para ang banter ay mas havey, Vice Ganda hosted the Miss Q and A segment with Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro. Kung na-miss n'yo ang bardagulan at puksaan ng trio, heto na, walang kulang!

Sa haba man ng kuwentuhan with candidates Divine Geralde, Vavaing Vurdado, at Mentoy Alexa Ang, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy.

Struggle is real ang ma ‘accla’ sa tawag sa baby Elephant, at pati sa lugar sa Bulacan kung saan sumasayaw ang mga babaeng humihiling na magka-anak. At ang iconic quote ni Julius Caesar, nabago na pala?!

Hirit ni Meme Vice, "Ang sakit sa bangs!" Pero bumawi naman sa Wit Lang round ang dalawang kandidatang pasok sa chukchakan, sina Mentoy at Vavaing Vurdado. Parang bumaliktad ang mga pangyayari, dahil ang performance ni Mentoy, bawing-bawi! Satisfied at masaya si Meme!Sa dulo, wagi si Mentoy bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Kasintapang ng kape ang fighting spirit ng mga baristang sumalang sa game arena kung saan sanib pwersa sina Vice Ganda at Karylle with Tyang Amy Perez.

Parang kape na ayaw mong tigilan, 'amats' naman ni Vice Ganda ang intern ng programa na biglang napasali pa sa aktingan. Samantala, para bang hindi basta aktingan lang ang hugot ni Ryan Bang kay Kim Chiu sa isang eksena. Hopia ba talaga?!

Saktong timpla ng swerte at diskarte ang mayroon si Ver, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante. Sumugal si Ver sa POT question, na may kinalaman tungkol sa kapeng barako.

description: The Q Agenda is hosted by a passionate community of Latinx LGBTQ+ personalities and influencers including, actress and trans activist Juliana Joel.

title: Emma Tiglao umupo bilang Miss Q and A hurado
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: WALANG WINNER TODAY sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang awitin, ginamit ni TNT champ JM Yosures ang boses para imulat ang mata ng mga Pilipino, na lahat tayo ay may kontribusyon upang labanan ang kahirapan.

Dahil brand new ang week, may fresh batch of "Miss Q and A" candidates na nag-hello sa "It's Showtime."Ganap na ganap sa puksaan at talakan sina Binibining Dana, Jinger Aman Villamor, at Wynzhl Bansagan.

Pagkatapos ng Tumpak Ganern round, sina Jinger at Binibining Dana ang nakalusot, samantalang si Wynzhl ay umuwing lotlot" Anong mas ayaw mo kapag matutulog, ‘yung may maingay na aso o may katabi na amoy aso?" ang tanong na nabunot ni Jinger. Sakto because she's a loving fur mom! Pero mukhang hindi sumakto ang sagot niya kina hurados Bianca Umali, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves. Gano'n din ang komento nila sa sagot ni Binibining Dana, na tumalak tungkol sa mga bestie na snaky.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, parang walang winner today. Pero maya-maya pa ay kinoronahan ang totoong reyna. Sa araw na 'to, si Jinger ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Samantala, ginamit din ni Brent Manalo ang boses para 'tumalak' sa ipapatayong AI and semiconductor industrial hub, Pax Silica, sa kanyang hometown sa Tarlac. At sa pagbabalik ni Darren, naipit si Jackie Gonzaga, na sa sobrang haba ng hair ay balik-love triangle with Darren at Brent.

Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, nagpahinga muna ang mga players na masahista. Minalas no'ng una pero bumawi ang swerte kay player Budang, na nabunot para sa jackpot round. No'ng una ay ipinaglaban niya ang POT para sa inang may cancer, at kapatid na may sakit sa puso. Pero, minsan panalo na rin ang sigurado, kaya sa dulo, forda Li-Pot na si Budang sa halagang P30,000. Sinunod niya si nanay.

description: Q is a suspense thriller which revolves around a group of friends who come together to find one after the other being killed mysteriously. The story circles around these mysterious murders. Why and what is the reason behind these murders is the essence of the story Q Premaku Chavuku.

title: Miss Q&A Martie, gustong mag-back out?
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: GALIT AKO! Miss Q&A Bb. Talinghaga kumasa sa aktingan
description:
Very timely ang rakrakan na hatid ng tatlong fan-favorites sa latest season ng Tawag Ng Taghalan—sina Kisen Abrogar, Will De Sosa, at Jeanel Silvestre, na pinukaw agad hindi lamang ang energy, kundi ang 'feels' ng Madlang People.

Pakak kung pakak ang lineup ng candidates sa June 29 episode ng "It's Showtime." Mukhang nasala nang mabuti ang batch na 'to, kaya walang tapon sa tatlo! Kung talakan ang usapan, palaban sina June Pangilinan, Khaye Corpuz, at Bb. Talinghaga.

Si June na fluent sa English, very smart ang atake as she talked about her museum adventures. Kung fluent si June sa English, matatas naman sa wikang Filipino si Bb. Talinghaga. At kahit tahimik sa umpisa, huwag 'anchahin' si Candidate #2, Khaye, dahil siya naman ay matatas sa swardspeak o gay lingo.

Dahil brainy ang mga kandidata for today's video, swabe lang ang tanungan sa Tumpak Ganern round. At hindi sila takot bumoses kahit pa maglabas ng galit sa gobyerno.

Nagtuloy-tuloy ang nakabibilib na 'chukchakan' sa Wit Lang, kung saan sina June at Bb. Talinghaga ang nagpuksaan. Kung gaano ka-witty ang 'say' ng mga kandidata sa entablado, gano'n din ang komento ng mga hurado, na sina Vince Maristela, Karylle at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao.

June is the month of weddings, sabi nga nila. Kaya naman mga bagog kasal na ginang ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pang-teleserye ang love story ni Nanay Lina, na sa edad na 67 ay ikinasal kay Virgilio, na itinuturing siyang first love. Patunayy lang sila na kahit anong edad, lumipas man ang panahon, basta iginuhit ng tadhana, magtatagpo ang dalawang puso. Teka, bakit mukhang affected si Kim Chiu?

Parang pelikula rin ang kwento ni Ayhie, na finally ay ikinasal na matapos ma-diagnose sa sakit na cancer. Habang patuloy siyang lumalaban sa sakit, hindi nagkukulang sa pagmamahal at pasensya si mister, na itinuturing din niyang best friend.

Mukhang kay Ayhie talaga ang araw na 'to! Dahil naibahagi na niya ang kanyang kuwento bago maglaro, siya pa ang nabunot para sa jackpot round. Kung anong desisyon ni misis, aprub kay mister. Kaya si Ayhie ang nasunod at tinanggap niya ang Li-Pot offer.

title: OGs plus Gen Zs! Vice, Anne, Darren, Brent nagkulitan sa Miss Q&A
description:
Ang mga divas ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan, pagdating sa kantahan, siguradong palaban at walang inuurungan. Intense na birit ang bitbit nina Carmelle Ccollado, Lyka Estrella, Arvery Lagoring, at Marielle Montellano na sanib-pwersa sa pagkanta ng "Gusto Ko Nang Bumitaw."

In real life, may gusto rin ba silang bitawan? Heto pa ang hindi mo gugustuhing palampasin. Si Jillian Ward, kumasa sa 'Meme' dance challenge. Si Ogie Alcasid, hindi mapigilang mag-reminisce. Parang kailan lang, si Jillian ay little girl na makulit pero ngayon isa nang binibining marikit.

Sina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, Brent Manalo, at Darren Espanto nag-collab sa pag-host ng Miss Q and A segment para sa September 4 episode. Si Brent, hindi mapakali dahil katabi niya ang crush na "Dyosa." Hanggang sa nauwi ang kulitan sapersonalan?!

Tatlong kandidata ang rumampa para subukan ang kanilang wit sa Miss Q and A. Meet Jessy Fami, Maria Princess Joy Rosario, at Hera Sanchez Santivañez. Sina Hera at Maria ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, kung saan hinarap nila ang questions na may kasamang playtime geography lessons? Kay Hera, “Kung kalbo ka, titira ka pa ba sa Laguna?” habang kay Maria naman tumapat ang tanong na, “Pwede bang maglakad ang mga bakla sa Baclaran?”

Kapag swerte ang kumatok, dapat agad pagbuksan. Dahil baka ito na ang araw na papabor sa'yo ang kapalaran. Lahat ng hamon ay kakayanin because they can! Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, bumida ang mga taga-Bocaue, Bulacan.

Ang dating line cook na si Kurt ang naka-survive sa lahat ng challenges at umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang niyang sinugalan ang P200,000 POT question. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer pero sayang nga naman ang pagkakataon.

title: Miss Q&A Lucky, may love advice sa co-candidate na NBSB
description:
Pagkatapos ng kanyang historic win sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan' Ika-10 Taon, noong nakaraang linggo, nagbabalik si Yannie Paul Basical sa entablado upang muling iparinig ang tinig na nangibabaw sa TNT stage.

Ang mga beki sa "Miss Q and A," parang naka-unli cups of coffee sa taas ng energy. Sa rampahan pa lang ay to the maximum level na ang bardagulan ng mga contestants—Queen Angie ng Rizal, Jerica Perater ng Leyte, at Lucky Rosales Collins ng Manila.

No'ng isang araw, may napagdudahan ang kabaklaan. At parang déjà vu, mayro'ng muntik nang 'imbestigahan' for today's video. Ang "It's Showtime" hosts, parang duda kung 19 years old ba talaga si Contestant #2!

Promise, bagets pa siya, kaya nga hindi pa nagkaka-jowa! At para ipa-feel naman kay Jerica ang tamis ng pumapag-ibig, siya'y pinakilig ni Ryan Bang, ang ating 'oppa,' sa isang ekena na nagtapos sa slow-mo moment ala K-Drama.

At parang slow-mo rin ang performance ng mga kandidata sa TumPak Ganern round. Sina Lucky at Queen Angie naman ang nagtalakan sa ‘Wit Lang’ kung saan pumili sila ng magkaibang katanungan.

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagdating sa aktingan, all-star cast ang eksenang digmaan. Walang nakapaghanda sa 'props' na dala ni Vice Ganda. Ang mga hosts, hindi na nakaiwas! Si Meme may mga dalang 'pasabog' at panlaban, kaya ang digmaan ay nauwi sa katatawanan!

Sa dami ng nangyari, si player Ali ang kinapitan ng swerte. Ang Li-Pot offer, itinodo na sa P30K! Alin ang pipiliin ni Ali?

title: MC at Lassy nagtrain kay Miss Q&A Mikkay
description:
Siguradong mapapangiti ka sa kilig dahil not just one, but four Gen Zs ang bumisita sa "It's Showtime" today. Sina "PBB Collab 2.0" heartthrobs Heath Jornales, Marco Masa, at John Clifford, at Big Winner Caprice Cayetano, kumasa sa "Ooh Lala Baby! Cuties!

On fire ang mga Miss Q and A candidates as they faced the toughest and most mind-boggling questions. Sina Jers Sabado, AC Faulkerson, at Mikkay Clemente ang nagharap-harap sa 'chukchakan' at puksaan ng talent. 'Yun nga lang, si Mikkay, talent daw ang "magmahal nang paulit-ulit kahit nasasaktan."

Mabilis ang naging sautan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa natira sina Mikkay at Jers para magharap sa Wit Lang kung saan may kinalaman sa mga fairytale characters ang tanong.

"Bakit naka-cropped top si Winnie the Pooh? Gen Z ba siya?" Sagot ni Mikkay, kailangan talagang mag-adapt sa changing times. Ang nabunot naman ni Jers, "Papayag ka bang ikaw si Rapunzel pero buhok sa ilong ang mahaba sayo?" Ang sagot niya, oo, dahil hindi siya makikinig sa mga panghuhusga sa kanyang pisikal na itsura.

Swerte ay tumama sa isang lucky player na naghatid ng saya at game na humarap sa challenges sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, featuring Madlang Players na mga taga-Taguig.

Sanay pumito si player Mike pero break muna siya sa trabaho bilang referee. Si Botchok naman, parang walang break ang pagkukuwento, naidagdag pa nga niya ang tips on how to spot a plastic na kamag-anak.

Walang plastikan, sobrang saya ng aktingan sa You Gotta Lyric round! Si Amy Perez, may pamana kina MC at Lassy! Si Jugs Jugueta naman ay ginulo ng anghel at demonyo, na itago na lang natin saa pangalang Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Bago sumalang sa laro, panalangin ni Kevs ay ibigay sa kanya ang swerte kung ito ay meant to be! At sa kanya nga iginuhit ni destiny ang pagiging lucky! Para sa kanyang pinakamamahal na lola, naging praktikal si Kevs at tinanggap ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: After We're Over
description: One fateful Saturday, Zelzah (Adrienne Rose White) receives a call out of the blue from her ex, Sazerac (Chris Mollica). It's the first she's heard from him in the year since he broke her heart and left St. Louis to move home to Long Island. Wearily, Zelzah decides to grab breakfast with him, which turns into a day-long exploration of the city of St. Louis - and their failed relationship. Over the course of the day, the film slips in time. As the two come together in the present, we see them fall apart in the past, their memories bleeding into their current conversations. While visiting some of the city's most famous landmarks, they discuss love, death, sex, politics, memory, and what we owe to each other and ourselves, as well as the ultimate question: can they begin again after they're over?

title: We're Your Parents
description: After college freshman Erin Coleman comes home for Thanksgiving, she notices something strange and disturbing about her parents, and the secret they are hiding in the basement.

title: You're Fired
description: Railroad magnate Gordon Rogers agrees to allow his daughter, Helen, to marry wealthy idler Billy Deering, Jr., but only if the latter can hold the same job for one month. Billy is hired for an array of jobs, including office clerk and xylophone player, but always quits just before being fired. He then finds work in a restaurant where he is required to dress as a knight in armor and pose as a statue. On one occasion, Gordon, Helen, and Billy's romantic rival, Tom, enter the restaurant, and Billy is nearly fired when Helen recognizes him. Meanwhile, Gordon plans to merge one of his railroads with a company that is in a dispute with Tom's uncle, an unprincipled financier. Acting on the promise of a generous cash reward, Tom is determined to steal documents relating to the merger. Billy manages to stay at his job for thirty days, and in the process, exposes Tom's scheme, winning Gordon's consent to marry Helen.

title: You're My Hero S1-S2
description: Ian, a man in his 20's with cerebral palsy, tries to find love and purpose in a world not designed for wheels while navigating the pressures of adulthood.

title: The R&B Feeling
description: 1971, the Los Angeles performance art scene is flourishing. Chris Burden has just ordered a studio assistant to shoot him in the left arm with a rifle, Barbara T Smith is staging provocative interventions at F-Space, and Paul McCarthy is painting his naked body with mustard and ketchup in the name of art. And among them all, Bob Parks: an energetic young artist from the UK, living with his beautiful and interesting San Fransiscan wife, Myriam Morales. Life is perfect, for a time. But when Bob's marriage fails, and Myriam leaves for Santa Fe, things fall apart. He walks the streets of Los Angeles for a year in a string bikini and sees his burgeoning art career come to pieces. Having been rescued by the parishioners of a South Central gospel church, and having spent six years worshipping and singing alongside them, Bob finally moves back to the UK to live with his parents in the New Forest. Despite planning to stay for only six months to finish a series of paintings and gather his thoughts, Bob stays for thirty years. We meet him as he continues to develop his art practice, continues to sing in a gospel church and continues to explore what he calls "the R&B feeling". Against this backdrop, Bob attempts to break free of a constraining and mutually dependent relationship with his mother, Miggie, whose health is failing. As time goes on Bob's obsession with his mother - and her impending death - deepens, before reaching a terrible and tragic conclusion.

title: Ziggy: Soreyuke! R&R Band
description: Japanese rock band Ziggy comes to London and gets attacked upon arrival at the hotel after a recording session. The musicians barely escape the attack; however, soon they learn that their producer has been murdered, and they are the suspects. Chased by police and some mysterious organization, they find shelter at a local rockers' place and even give a performance there; but it is not too long before their pursuers appear again.

title: Terry R. Wickham's Anomaly
description: A paranormal research team of three men investigates a remote location long rumored to be haunted. They vanish without a trace. A female police officer investigating the case befriends three women connected with the missing men. Together they search for answers surrounding the researchers' frightening disappearance. A force beyond anything they could ever imagine enters their lives to prevent them from learning the truth. Each of their destinies is forever altered following a series of terrifying encounters with the unknown. In the end, they must test the bands of their friendship and survive the night in one final showdown with the malevolent beings intent on their destruction.

title: Surviving R. Kelly S1-S3
description: A six-part series about the controversial R&B star R. Kelly which features several women making allegations of abuse by him.

title: Prescription R
description: Richard is on the run from Glasgow's criminal underworld, after the collapse of its drug manufacturing operation. When he turns to his friend for help things will take a dark turn for the worst, before descending into chaos.

title: C(r)ook
description: A killer for the Russian Mafia in Vienna wants to retire and write a book about his passion - cooking. The mafia godfather suspects treason.

title: Movement (R)evolution Africa
description: In an astonishing exposition of choreographic fomentation, nine African choreographers tell stories of an emergent art form and their diverse and deeply contemporary expressions of self. Stunning choreography and riveting critiques challenge stale stereotypes of "traditional Africa" to unveil soul-shaking responses to the beauty and tragedy of 21st century Africa.

title: Patel S.I.R
description: Subhash Patel (Jagapathi Babu), a retired army officer, takes on a group of drug traffickers. ACP Catherine, a corrupt lady officer, vows to find out the reason behind his mission.

title: R&B Divas
description: Each has had their ups and each have had their downs -- all in the harsh light of stardom. Faith Evans, Nicci Gilbert, Monifah Carter, Syleena Johnson and KeKe Wyatt -- five strong women who have been broken down and are rebuilding from the ground up. R&B Divas takes you inside the lives of these music stars as they work, play and struggle to get their lives and careers back on track. Brought together by their friendship and love of R&B goddess Whitney Houston, these incredible singers are dealing with everything from divorce to drugs and sexuality.

title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead
description: When his brother disappears and everyone forgets he existed, Sam must unravel the mystery before Finn is gone forever.

title: R U the Boy?
description: Scandocious J.r. has seen the heights of his career being appreciated for his musical talents as an openly gay rapper/singer. The only thing he hasn't been able to accomplish is finding true love. To make this distant dream a reality Scandocious J.r. enlists his closest friends to help him find Mr right. Put on your seat belts, and get ready to find out if he can find his one, and only!

title: We're Here S4
description: A trio of drag queens descend upon various American towns and cities to inspire and teach their own "drag daughters" to step outside their comfort zone for a night of no-holds-barred full-on drag.

title: Honest Man: The Life of R. Budd Dwyer
description: Honest Man: the Life of R. Budd Dwyer is a movie about politics and corruption, suicide and survival. Four years in the making, it explores the scandal that led an honest, hard-working man to take his own life. This independently produced feature-length documentary follows Budd Dwyer, a Pennsylvania politician who infamously committed suicide at a televised press conference. The film chronicles Dwyer's meteoric rise to political power and examines the bribery scandal and subsequent trial that pushed him to his breaking point. Honest Man also delves into the controversy and consequences of the uncensored airing of Dwyer's death on television stations worldwide. Honest Man reveals a story that has remained untold for over 24 years. The film features exclusive new interviews, including William Smith, the man whose testimony convicted Dwyer, and Dwyer's widow Joanne--her last interview before her death in 2009. Was Dwyer venal, or a victim? Did he kill himself because he couldn't live with being guilty, or because he couldn't live with being innocent? Honest Man allows audiences to judge for themselves.

title: S.O.N.S. (Sons of Nanay Sabel)
description: S.O.N.S. (Sons of Nanay Sabel)

title: Allegro s ognyom
description: In June 1941, the fascists tried to block the Black Sea Fleet in Sevastopol, throwing new top-secret magnetic-acoustic mines into the channel. To neutralize this formidable weapon, a special group of volunteers was created.

title: Assassin(s)
description: Old professional killer Wagner seeks someone to teach what he knows as long as he is already dying, and he chooses Max, young and passionless thief to be his successor.

title: S#*! Talk
description: We follow the lives of best friends, Sav and Ray, as they hilariously navigate their way through their 20-somethings.

title: CHAMPION(S)
description: As promising young athletes, they share the same crazy dream : to be at the 2024 Olympics. CHAMPION(S) is a docuseries shot inside INSEP, the French Olympic training center in Paris to tell a story that mixes hopes, doubts and the weight of sacrifices.

title: Doctor S
description: Report Jane Aldrige is summoned to do an interview by the reclusive Doctor Strangematter. She finds herself in over her head, and the only person who can come to her rescue is the masked vigilante Cobra.

title: S' agapo
description: A sensitive young woman falls for an older man, a doctor, but has to deal with the onset of his terminal illness.

title: Lyubov s oruzhiem
description: Love, the central character, is a certified psychologist who specializes in dealing with wayward and rebellious youths. She is currently preparing for her wedding with Maksim. One night when driving home, Max and Love are involved in an accident after their car hits a man on the road. On examining the body, Max is shocked to discover that the man is dead. Please turn on Closed Captions.

title: Dívka s muslí
description: Thirteen-year-old Vendula (Dita Kaplanová) dozes off at school and dreams about her parents riding in a carriage dressed in their wedding clothes. The young teacher is angry with the girl who has already failed a year, and has no idea that she is looking after three younger half-brothers. They all have a different father and their mother (Evelyna Steimarová) comes home noisy and drunk every day, often accompanied by a man. Early in the morning, Vendula helps her mother clean offices, and sometimes has to do the cleaning all by herself. Her eldest brother Libor is good at school and blindly adores his mother. Jeník is a talented flute player and much more cynical. The youngest Venousek is still a toddler. The only one who is cared of is Vendula by her father (Ladislav Frej), who has divorced his confirmed alcoholic wife years ago and has another daughter in his new family. All his attempts to persuade Vendula to move in with them are in vain. The girl is selflessly trying to keep the family together.

title: Lyubov s aktsentom
description: Colorfully rich, and emotionally deep, "Love with Accent" is a film that explores several very different love stories. These are true stories of human feelings, bright and passionate, mature and merciless. They range from the naïve and absurd, to the odd and comical, to the lucky, to the melancholy.

title: Sluchay s patsanom
description: Yura - a guy from the workers' quarter far from politics - by the will of fate finds himself drawn into the maelstrom of political events.

title: Project S
description: A search for the power of good design and the influence of an object on the heart.

title: S.O.S. Titanic
description: On her maiden voyage in April 1912, the supposedly unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic strikes an iceberg in the Atlantic Ocean.

title: Politseyskiy s Rublyovki
description: Returning from vacation, the head of the Barvikha police department, Yakovlev receives a new appointment: he becomes the head of the Russian Police Academy created on Rublevka.

title: Prince Hours
description: Winning the hand of the queen means becoming the future king. Queen Hwa In (Myung Se Bin) is the reigning queen but the fact that she is still single and has no heir concerns the imperial court. Although she has been in love with Alexander (Marc Andre Jourdan), her half-Korean, half-English professor from Oxford, she sacrificed her own happiness in order to do what's right for her people.

title: Louis T veut savoir
description: -A documentary series through which the humorist bridges the gap between the public and scientific researchers. Louis T investigates to find explanations to divisive subjects, which he himself struggles to understand or which confront him in his daily life. With statistics and verified facts, each episode is an exciting encounter between scientific popularization and humor.

title: Mister T.
description: Anything is possible in Warsaw rising from the war rubble in 1953. The omnipresent uncertainty, denunciations, and the sense of constant surveillance are tamed with the help of vodka and good company. A renowned writer, Mister T. lives in a hotel for authors and makes a living by giving extra lessons. One day, a young countryside man moves into the next-door flat with big dreams of working as a journalist. Mister T. becomes his mentor and teacher. The pace of the protagonist's life quickens once the authorities begin to suspect him of an evil wish to blow up the Palace of Culture and Science, and Secret Police agents start to watch every move he makes. It is hard to stay serious in this ridiculous reality.

title: The T
description: Jo, a white trans woman craving an increasingly elusive intimacy, Carter, a queer Black man at odds with his conservative upbringing, and Emerie, a Latina trans woman stuck in an incompatible relationship, all converge from different parts of Chicago for a magical New Year's Eve night. As hangovers fade, and the three friends face awkward hook-ups, nervous dates, and the unlikely pursuit of lasting love, at least they have each other.

title: Vjeruj u ljubav
description: "Vjeruj u ljubav" was licensed reality show broadcasted on Croatian RTL television hosted by actor Danijel Ljuboja. The purpose of the show was to connect various people and give them opportunity to start or continue their once broken relationship. The show was not limited only to people who developed romantic feelings toward someone else but also included long lost friends, relatives and similar. People who were seeking contact usually would record video message for that special someone. The wanted person would watch the message and decide is she/he willing to establish the connection. The whole procedure was filmed and edited into feature stories as part of the episode. Each episode was consisted of studio part where people would finally meet and edited stories which explained the background of relations presented in the show.

title: Free Money
description: When universal basic income (UBI) comes to the Kenyan village of Kogutu, lives are forever changed. GiveDirectly, one of the fastest growing nonprofits of the 21st century, is sending free money for twelve years as part of the world's largest UBI experiment. Filmmakers Lauren DeFilippo and Sam Soko juxtapose the story of these young economists, bankrolled by Silicon Valley and convinced that they have found an infallible algorithm to end world poverty, with portraits of local Kenyans whose lives are being dramatically impacted for better and for worse. UBI is at the forefront of political debate like never before, thanks to Andrew Yang's presidential candidacy, covid stimulus packages, and trials underway around the world. This documentary is a fascinating case study of life in a village-turned-petri-dish from the perspective of those living out this revolutionary idea.

title: The Care They've Earned
description: It is a gripping look into six proud veterans' experiences with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) as they seek to manage the mental and physical trauma they sustained in uniform. The documentary details their experiences with an embattled VA - from botched surgeries to misdiagnoses to personnel shortfalls - and educates about the fundamental changes and reforms that are needed to ensure our veterans are taken care of in a way that honors their service. It asks viewers to reflect on serious and complex questions about what kind of care our veterans have earned after they hang up their uniforms and when, how, and where they receive that care. The Care They've Earned tells the stories of six veterans, but it highlights the struggles of finding adequate health care that all veterans face. It educates about the opportunity that more choices could mean for our veterans to receive the care they need - when and where they need it.

title: « L’ART DE LA GUERRE » l’incroyable Film RMC Sport avant BSD v PIMBLETT | UFC 329
description: Benoît Saint Denis est revenu plus fort que jamais pour signer des victoires exceptionnelles face à Ruffy, Dariush et Hooker et se hisser en quelques mois seulement dans le Top 5 de la catégorie des -70kg de l’UFC, poussant son corps au-delà de ses limites. Face à lui, la superstar anglaise Paddy Pimblett, qui reste sur une défaite héroïque face à Justin Gaethje, l’homme qui vient de choquer la planète en brutalisant Ilia Topuria, que tout le monde pensait invincible, lui arrachant au passage la ceinture de champion. Découvrez comment Benoît Saint Denis est devenu une machine de guerre implacable aux côtés de Nicolas Ott, en trouvant le juste équilibre entre violence brute, discipline et stratégie. Pimblett est lui dans l’obligation de se relever : une deuxième défaite de rang le renverrait en salle d’attente de la catégorie et sous le feu nourri des critiques liées à son image de produit marketing et de chouchou du patron. Seul le vainqueur pourra prétendre à affronter Justin Gaethje pour la ceinture. Une bataille à ne pas perdre. #UFC329 #InternationalFightWeek #GodOfWar #PaddyTheBaddy #Gaethje #Topuria #Tsarukyan #Hooker #Ruffy #Dariush #Holloway #McGregor #UFCFreedom250 00:00 L’Art de la Guerre 09 :12 BSD v Ruffy : la masterclass qui a tout changé 11 :50 BSD v Dariush : un KO des enfers en 16 secondes ! 15 :58 Hooker : BSD repousse ses limites 24 :45 Gaethje v Pimblett : Paddy perd la guerre mais gagne le respect 32 :52 Exclu RMC : au cœur de la prépa de BSD de Bayonne à Paris Ne manquez rien des combats de l’UFC en vous abonnant à RMC Sport 1 ► Toute l’actu UFC sur RMC Sport ► Suivez l’UFC avec RMC Sport sur tous nos réseaux ✓ Twitter ► Tiktok ► Facebook ► Instagram ► Tous les podcasts Fighter Club ► La playlist YouTube de l’UFC RMC Sport ► Les débriefs RMC MMA ►

title: Twarza w twarz
description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

title: Yom W Leila
description: The story revolves around a policeman who's investigating some social issues, especially those related to the crises of the poor inside the Mawlid of Al-Sayeda Zainab and the problems they face. problems they face.

title: A.W.O.L
description: Vietnam. 1972. US Army Special Forces Major Cliff Marquette leads a squad ordered to investigate unusual reports and secure a remote jungle temple locals believe has mystical powers. The Marines guarding the temple have withheld provisions for days from a Viet Cong prisoner. Despite severe mistreatment, the prisoner mysteriously shows no signs of suffering. Marquette confronts the Marine in charge, Garris for torturing a prisoner of war when suddenly enemy forces attack and mortar shells rock the temple. An exceptionally heroic, but losing battle lands Marquette in the hands of a merciless Viet Cong torturer. His men are dead; his screams unheeded. At the height of agony, Marquette's world is turned upside down. In an instant, he finds himself a stranger in the midst of an American life that apparently belongs to him - an idyllic but unrecognizable life complete with a loving wife and two children he's never seen before. Marquette struggles to take in what is happening to him. First is paranoia. Soon uncertainty and fear give way to relief and acceptance. But the twist of fate that delivered Marquette into this life from the hands of his enemy has granted him only a reprieve. The cruel pain of war is not over. As the clock strikes midnight Marquette is back in Vietnam where his torture resumes a few minutes each night. Desperately trapped between two worlds, Marquette must endure;unless, with the clock counting down, he can cheat fate. Escaping will take his wits;and it will require a gun.

title: W.E.
description: The affair between King Edward VIII and American divorcée Wallis Simpson, and a contemporary romance between a married woman and a Russian security guard.

title: W.
description: A woman has been found by the Luxembourgish police. She doesn't know who she is or what she is doing there but, strangely, she knows everything else. Who is this woman, main suspect in an investigation about the disappearance of children?

title: W Series
description: W Series is an all-female single-seater motor racing championship. It was created in response to the lack of female drivers within the motorsport industry and thus limit the chances of progressing to the highest levels of motorsport, particularly Formula 1. The series' first season was in 2019; it featured twenty drivers contesting six races.

title: Shamshoun & Dalila
description: In a blend of comedy, suspense, and action, Shamshon is forced to steal a legendary diamond to rescue his kidnapped sister, while Dalilah is mysteriously tasked with stealing it for herself. Their missions intersect in a chase filled with tricks, pranks, and clever confrontations, transforming their seemingly disparate paths into an unexpected love story. Ultimately, they are forced to join forces with an international alliance to determine who is the best and to seize the diamond at any cost.

title: Mardi w Dahham
description: It follows two brothers-in-law, Mardi and Dahham, and the many problems that take place between Mardiya and her husband Dahham, while Mardi attempts to reconcile them.

title: My Lovely Liar [Hindi]
description: Tells the story of a woman who cannot trust people because of her ability to hear lies and a murder suspect who no one believes in.

title: Tank Police Team TANK S.W.A.T. 01
description: Masamune Shirow presents a story about the Dominion Tank Police dealing with terrorists taking over the NT Building with AI driven tanks.

title: Kamen Rider W Returns: Kamen Rider Accel
description: While settling into married life with Akiko, Ryu is brought into a case involving a woman named Katsuragi Aoi, a member of a pickpocketing ring with most of her teammates murdered from unknown masked vigilantes that Ryu fought as Accel.

title: Dimension W [English]
description: In the year 2072, the world's energy problems seem solved by a network of cross-dimensional electric-field inductors called "coils" that extract energy from a seemingly infinite source. That source is the W dimension, a fourth plane that exists beyond the X, Y, and Z dimensions. In this world, unofficial "illegal" coils harness powers that the police can't hope to counter. Dealing with these coils is the job of coil-hating repo man Kyoma, whose run-in with the unique coil android Mira leads the two to form a reluctant partnership.

title: F.T.W.
description: Frank T. Wells has just been released from prison after serving a term for manslaughter. Frank's a reasonably honest man and a good rodeo rider. When he meets up with Scarlett, a bank robber on the run, his whole life changes.

title: 1 on 1's w/Deuces
description: Young Deuces of the Geekset Podcast host a new interview show where he speaks with creators, curators and people you should know about Geek Culture and Hip-Hop Culture in a more in depth way than before. With conversations about stigma's, preferences, perceptions and more: 1 on 1's w/Deuces becomes one of the leaders in Blerd conversation and changes the narrative on what a Blerd is and what it truly means to be a Geek.

title: We are alright
description: After quitting their corporate jobs, Bartek and Rafal decided to create their first video game. The movie follows them throughout the last few months of working on the project. You'll be able to witness their struggle to publish the game on PlayStation, the emotions of people associated with the game's launch, and finally, Rafal's and Bartek's attempts to break into the consciousness of youtube stars and the industry press.

title: Inazuma Eleven GO VS Danball Senki W
description: LBX agents join forces with a soccer team from an alternative dimension to take down an enemy that puts both of their worlds into jeopardy.

title: "FALSE REAP" w/ Joseph Watson
description: Joseph Watson, formerly known as Baby Joe instructs how he enters into leg attacks using what is known as the "false reap". A very tricky and unforeseen entry when an opponent is using a knee slice or combat base. Always on the mend of evolving techniques, Joe is an incredible athlete and an even better teacher.

title: Keeper of the Ashes: The Oklahoma Girl Scout Murders
description: The investigation into the murders of three young Oklahoma Girl Scouts at sleepaway camp in 1977!

title: Herbert. Barbarzynca w ogrodzie
description: Polish author Zbigniew Herbert is one of the most remarkable poets of the 20th century. His works have been translated into 40 languages, acclaimed and awarded around the world, mainly because of its timeless and universal dimension. In Poland, his significance is even greater, as Herbert was a moral guide in his native country. His poetry was of great importance during the fight against communism. Many Poles learned his poems by heart and remember them up to this day. However, behind the crystalline beauty of his poetry, there is a man struggling with everyday life. His story told by his wife, Katarzyna, and people who were close to him unveils a picture of a unique, yet complex artist. A model of intelligence, humor and charm, on the one hand, Herbert has been struggling with anger, physical pain and mental illness, on the other.

title: 100 Days My Prince [Hindi]
description: Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner's life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon's oldest bachelorette.

description: A high octane, near future thriller about twins Bax and April. When April goes missing, Bax searches every dark corner of the post Soviet cityscape trying to find her, ultimately descending into madness.

title: Y
description: A Balkan war veteran - who is now a homeless alcoholic - dreams that he is a tree growing inside the ruins of his house, which was destroyed in a bombing raid.

title: Y
description: Olga's carefree life and family dynamics slowly starts shifting after her grandmother, a very wealthy lawyer, makes an unexpected confession on her deathbed.

title: Serrat y Sabina: el símbolo y el cuate
Apaga... y vámonos
description: A somewhat confused and strange young inventor, named Gustavo, is arrested by the police accused of being a terrorist. Through his statements we will know the truth of the facts. During his childhood he discovers that his father wants to escape to a place called Vesta aboard a spaceship made by himself. However, during the journey he loses his life. Now thirty years old, Gustavo, after a series of events, will try to repeat his father's journey.

title: Lluvia y ceniza
description: Jaime is an unsuccessful painter who lives in his house, accompanied by Blanca, who suffers psychological abuse from him.

title: Calor... y celos
description: Carlos prepares a trip a Cuba with his lover. His plans are spoiled when his wife makes up her mind to go to Havana with him.

title: Palos y risas
description: In a town of violence and crime, a policeman works sternly. But with his cheerful, outgoing personality, he becomes the clown TRAMPOLIN.

title: Y También Gaelle
description: In 2010 an earthquake shooked Haiti, reducing the poorest country in America to rubble. A team of Spanish firefighters, accompanied by the rescue dog Turco became the protagonists of one of the most media rescue: two years old Redjeson, was found alife 48 hours after the earthquake, becoming a symbol of hope. One year after the tragedy, when the world seems to have forgotten about the little island, three Spanish firefighters decide to return to search for Redjeson and try to get their wounds to heal.

title: Barridos y regados
description: Two men bring a message to a manager in an office with two beautiful secretaries. The manager thinks they are the specialists he is waiting for. They see the opportunity to make Money and to conquest the women. So they go through different challenges untill the real specialists arrive.

title: Topo y Wera
description: Topo y Wera is the result of Jean-Charles Hue's engagement with the poorest residents of the Mexican border-city of Tijuana that has long thrived on its proximity to California, but is also marked by crime-ridden deprivation. This is tough, unvarnished stuff; a glimpse into lives on the hardscrabble margins of society that many may find too much to stomach.

title: X Y & Zee
description: The venomous and amoral wife of a wealthy architect tries, any way she can, to break up the blossoming romance between her husband and his new mistress; a good-natured young widow who holds a dark past.
