title: Estudiantes y modistillas
description: Soledad and Lola work as seamstresses in a typical Madrid neighborhood. When Julio, a law student from a wealthy family, leaves Soledad pregnant and abandons her, she asks for help to the Paloma Virgin. Julio becomes a barrister, and has to defend an abandoned woman. Realizing his own faults, he will now get back to Soledad. Shot in Madrid on location in the Retiro park, Puerta del Sol, Paloma Church and other spots of zarzuelistic fame.

title: ¿Y los tamales?
description: A Honduran cabbie is entrusted with picking up a payload of tamales for Christmas Eve. On his journey, he picks up some spicy characters that all have their secrets to hide. Together, they take a long taxi ride into comical redemption.

title: Cocolos y Rockeros
description: This documentary examines the musical tastes of Puerto Rico's youth. The terms "cocolos" refers to those who prefer "salsa" music, and "rockeros" to those who prefer "rock" music. Through interviews and an array of musical settings the film explores the young people's feelings in a humorist yet serious manner, bringing to the forefront issues of biases and national identity inherent in this innocent yet very powerful form of social entertainment. Includes musical performances by Gilberto Santa Rosa, El Gran Combo, REO Speedwagon and others.

title: Terror y feria
description: Collection of small, independent stories, with the premise that all of them are terror/bizarre related.

title: Martes y trece
description: Lola and Maria are two Spanish young ladies engaged to Franz and Pepe, all so eager to spend their honeymoon that the moment seems never to come, as all sorts of problems pave their way.

title: Vas-y Coupe!
description: A motley crew of laborers makes the yearly trek to a vineyard in France's Champagne region to pick grapes for a famed winemaker, but as his son begins to take the reins it is unclear if this harvest tradition can endure. A pure vérité portal into two disparate French worlds entwined.

title: Chasing Luck(Y)
description: A man who plays lottery for years suddenly wins 4 million euros, despite his previous lack of success. However, a winning ticket somehow finds its way to the hands of local pub's owners. After finding out that the police and two local crooks are after them, they escape to Greece, but their hosts mistakenly make announcement of the lottery winners over all mediums. From that point, everybody sets out on the way to Greece hoping to find the missing ticket.

title: Orgullo y Prejuicio
description: A pesar de la presión social para casarse, Lizzie Bennet, la segunda de las hermanas Bennet, está decidida a quedarse soltera. Pero cuando su padre cae gravemente enfermo, Lizzie se ve inesperadamente arrastrada al mundo clasista del cortejo con tal de salvar a su familia de la ruina. Tras un encuentro decisivo con el reservado y misterioso millonario, el señor Darcy, Lizzie se enfrenta a una elección: negar sus sentimientos por el bien de su familia o dejarse llevar por un amor tan apasionado como imprudente.

title: Juárez y Maximiliano
description: From Maximilian's arrival in Mexico to his execution in Querétaro.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, a frustrated detective, receives a second chance when he is forced to adopt his 10 year old brother (who happens to be a child prodigy). With his help, Franco will solve the most complicated mysteries.

title: Helena y Fernanda
description: An important industrialist suffers a neurosis. In a violent argument he strikes his wife and apparently kills her. Then the body disappears. Criminal melodrama inspired by a similar situation set out by Henri Georges Clouzot in 'Les diaboliques'.

title: 70 Y Pico
description: Grandpa, why did they try to kill you? The documentary addresses the animic changes that the filmmaker experiences while he tries to understand the participation that his grandfather played, as a civil associate, during the last military dictatorship in Argentina. The role that he played as the Dean of the Architecture Faculty at the University of Buenos Aires, as a link with the concentration camp ESMA, is one of the multiple topics that grandpa "Pico" narrates in camera.

title: Perros y Diablos
description: A bank robbery goes wrong, and Cobra is the only one who served time for it. 10 years later, those involved reunite to celebrate his release from prison, but things have changed, and the new gathering of friends turns out to be different.

title: Rosas y Espadas
description: Sandra luchó en la batalla en lugar de su padre y fue nombrada Gran General. El emperador quiso concederle un matrimonio, pero ella reveló su identidad femenina. Renunció a su título y regresó a su hogar. Para compensarla, el emperador nombró a su prometido, David. Sin embargo, se casó con Lisa, quien fingía ser la hermana del general. Cuando el reino vuelve a caer en el caos, el canciller Alberto la trajo de vuelta. Al final, los dos alcanzaron sus ideales y se quedaron juntos.

title: Sal y Pimienta
description: A Spanish talk show where the latest scoops of mostly Hispanic pop culture is reported on.

title: Fulano y Mengano
description: The stay in the prison of Eudosio and Carlos, accused unjustly, prevents them from getting a job when they go free. As much as they intend to explain that they were locked up for no reason, nobody will listen to them. So they decide to steal to stay alive. His house is a whole building in ruins, without any closed window and with the walls that are barely standing. Esperanza will try to turn that space into a home, where she works with enthusiasm. But life is very hard and coexistence is also difficult.

title: Locos y Sueltos
description: In the city of Miami Beach came the idea of surprising tourists and messing with the locals routine through uncommon and funny tactics. By showing them spicy situations in which visitors to this sunny city become the stars. "Locos y Sueltos" is born. The show is hosted by Santamonica, whose debut has captivated us all with her refreshing beauty.

title: Generation Y
description: A group of ragtag twenty year olds find themselves wanting more out of life in the city of Angels.

title: Cásate y Verás
description: The adventures and misadventures of married couples at different stages of life with humor and laughter.

title: YRYR S1-S3
description: A Comedy Series that revolves around the daily lives of the Amusement Club, consisting of Akari Akaza, her childhood friends, Kyoko Toshino and Yui Funami, and her classmate Chinatsu Yoshikawa

title: Mariana y Scarlett
description: Amor, desamor, envidia y traición son los ingredientes de la nueva novela Mariana y Scarlett, la historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son dos mujeres de clase media, bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran anhelo de superación. Pero ahí terminan los parecidos. Mientras Mariana es seria, dulce, serena y quiere hacer todo por el camino correcto; Scarlett es divertida, pícara, agresiva y quiere hacer todo por el camino rápido. El deseo de la primera es montar su propio taller de confecciones y hacer sus propios diseños, el de la segunda es ser una modelo internacionalmente reconocida. En su camino hacia el cumplimiento de su sueño ambas se cruzarán con Roberto White, un millonario dueño de una textilera, cuyo matrimonio está roto y que, mientras consigue el divorcio, saldrá con las dos hermanas pero con identidades diferentes. Con Scarlett será Roberto, millonario y empresario, mientras que con Mariana será Boby, empleado en una agencia de seguridad. Cuando Roberto se da cuenta de que se ha enamorado de Mariana, romperá con Scarlett, pero la dicha no lo durará mucho, ya que Mariana no tardará en descubrir el engaño, lo que le llevará a romper con él para siempre. Scarlett por su parte descubre que Roberto la abandonó por Mariana, lo que hace que su relación de hermanas se afecte de manera irreversible. Scarlett y Mariana se convierten entonces en rivales por la lucha del amor de un hombre, Roberto.

title: Las dos y media y... veneno
description: The old Don Senén has squandered in sprees the inheritance of his niece Begoña rather than manage it. There is still a million pesetas, which will only be delivered after the death of Don Senén. To get it, the old man, in complicity with Begoña and two other nephews (Ramón and Marcos) will fake his death. But Ramón and Marcos really planned to poison their uncle putting cyanide in his milk to keep them with money - When poor Quintín, Justo and Paloma (funeral parlor's workers) arise at Don Senén's home they will find an overview full of misunderstandings.

title: Casada y señorita
description: Jealousy and rivalries in a newly married couple of artists.

title: Marcelo y María
description: In the sixteenth century, two young indigenous fall in love, but being slaves, they will have to submit to their masters or fight for their love at all cost.

title: Agus y Lui, Churros y Crafts
De barro y oro
description: Like so many young people in Spain, Manuel comes to Madrid from his village with the illusion of being a bullfighter. Upon arrival he meets Juan, a flamenco singer older than him and penniless who, together with his friend Lola, will help the boy to get the opportunity to participate in a bullfight on the estate of a famous businessman.

title: Genio y figura
description: When the pregnant Esther gets some bad news from her doctor, he advises her to visit a clinic in Mexico City, so she enlists husband Antonio to drive her there at once, along with her brother Luis. As soon as the men drop her off at the hospital, they hit a local nightclub and live it up, and as they are leaving the club in the company of a sexy dancer, they get thoroughly robbed: the criminals even steal the poor victims' clothes! Taken in to the police station and documented along the way, their photograph turns up in the paper the next day, which Esther of course sees. The men will have a lot to explain when they arrive at the clinic to pick up Esther.

title: Traición y renacimiento
description: Hace siete años, Selene, mi hermana menor adoptiva y una delicada omega, atropelló a alguien estando ebria y huyó, derramando sangre en la Frontera del Territorio Humano. Mi padre alfa, mi madre luna y mi hermana biológica me hicieron la misma súplica condescendiente: Selene es una omega, es muy frágil para la prisión. Si va a la Penitenciaría Silvermoon, su loba no sobrevivirá. Lyra, toma su lugar, por favor. Me negué. Pero en una noche de tormenta, mi padre usó su mando absoluto de alfa. Destruyó mi voluntad, controló mi mente y me entregó personalmente al transporte de la prisión. Mi prometido y pareja destinada, Kaelen, el alfa más fuerte de la manada, contuvo su furiosa aura de lobo y me dijo: Lyra, cuando salgas, completaremos el vínculo. Solo resiste estos siete años.

title: Punto y raya
description: "Punto y raya" is the story of a young Colombian recruit who, while patrolling his country's border, is befriended by a Venezuelan adversary, and the tragic consequences of their relationship.

title: Susana y el sexo
description: Susana Estrada was the first artist in Spain to perform a full nude on stage, a striptease, assuming its innumerable consequences. Her constant involvement with the subject of sex cost her the suspension of her passport and the right to vote. Looking at the past through Susana's story is also looking at a Spain that repressed women, a struggle that still lasts today.

title: El Barbero y el Mendigo
description: A barber set in his ways gets his consciousness challenged by a homeless man who lacks the money to pay for a haircut but instead is willing to give that which keeps him warm.

title: Growing Up
description: Emma wakes up in her thirties to find herself a loser when her best friend Lola asks her to be the guardian of her about-to-be-born child.

title: Las detectivas y el Víctor
description: A married couple creates a detective agency.

title: El vicio y la virtud
description: Rosa, a shy and romantic girl of sixteen, spends the summer holiday in a lavish mansion with her widowed mother. Along the way they are accompanied by two young bachelor men as fate takes its course on the naive young girl.

title: Cuba canta y baila
description: A family of peasants win a lottery prize and must travel to Havana in order to claim it. They are amazed at all the musical entertainment in the big city but ignore that their lottery winnings are in danger.

title: Manuel y Clemente
description: Manuel and Clemente, couple in the shower and in various scheming, try to do business with miraculous apparitions. Near the Sevillian town of El Palmar de Troya, in 1968, people begin to say that the Virgin appears and the two friends take advantage of the situation. Soon a network of economic interests and credulity is created that makes it easier for Manuel and Clemente to achieve their goal: a monumental basilica, a religious order of nuns, priests and bishops of their own, and even a pope, Gregory XVII. Satire on the curious origin of the Palmarian Catholic Church and its unique founders.

title: Mi marido y sus complejos
description: A married man can't stand his mother-in-law and lives every day waiting for the night. That's when he gets the chance to let his hair down, go to a night club and escape from the monotony of his family life.

title: Susana y Elvira, La Serie
description: 'Susana and Elvira' is a web series that emerged from a blog that two young people created in 2008 to talk with total freedom about sex, relationships, and other everyday aspects of their life in relation to men.

title: Entre celos y desamor
description: Laura Rivas amó durante años a Pablo Gómez, sin saber que su afecto no era más que una estrategia para acercarla a Sergio Lima, heredero de la Mansión del Duque, y así sabotear el compromiso con Eva Santos. Al descubrir que solo fue un instrumento para provocar los celos de Eva, Laura, herida, llevó su engaño con Sergio hasta el matrimonio, mientras Pablo quedaba consumido por el arrepentimiento.

title: El amor y la ciudad
description:
Esta es la historia de Juana, Sebastián y Elisa. Estos tres personajes habitan el mismo edificio en una imaginaria Buenos Aires. La ciudad esta vacía, diferente. Todo sucede en pocas cuadras a la redonda.

Juana es una joven artista plástica desocupada, algo desquiciada y con graves problemas económicos. Desesperada y como ultimo recurso, pide ayuda a sus padres, que viven fuera del país, pero su madre se la niega. Entonces intenta conseguir empleo en el Bar de Pedro, un bar próximo a su casa. Tampoco tiene suerte. Le queda seguir retratando a sus vecinos a los que espía y dibuja a su manera.

Elisa, tiene bien pasados los cuarenta y cinco, es una mujer un tanto frustrada no sólo en lo profesional sino también en lo afectivo. Ha sido mantenida gran parte de su vida por su padre, Carlos Miguel un reconocido escritor que vive en Paris desde hace cuarenta años. Hace cinco que Elisa no ve a su padre y es en el Bar de Pedro donde Elisa se entera por medio de los noticiosos que Carlos Miguel a sido galardonado con el premio Nobel de literatura a los 80 años. Nadie sabe en la ciudad que Carlos Miguel es su padre y Elisa no lo dirá ahora tampoco.

Sebastián tiene unos treinta y pico y un futuro incierto. Se las rebusca de hurtar y vender los libros antiguos y particulares de su único familiar, el tío Augusto, un anciano excéntrico y solitario. Sebastián convive con Elisa desde hace tiempo, se aman, están bien juntos. Elisa y Sebastián son dos seres solitarios que se tienen el uno al otro. Pero Sebastián sospecha que hay otro hombre en la vida de Elisa, alguien que vive en Paris, y eso lo tiene alterado. Elisa recibe una llamada inesperada de su padre, que le pide fervientemente que lo vaya a ver ya que acaba de ser abandonado y su casa desvalijada por su más reciente pareja Natalie. Elisa parte, sin aviso alguno hacia Paris.

Al mismo tiempo en Buenos Aires Juana sufre un desmayo en la calle y es auxiliada por Sebastián que la lleva al hospital. Al arribar a Paris Elisa y Carlos Miguel recapitulan momentos vividos, hacen un recuento sobre quienes son y lo poco que se han dejado conocer el uno al otro. A Carlos Miguel no le queda mucho tiempo de vida, el sufre de un problema de coagulación que lo desmejora día a día. Para su alivio esta allí su única hija, Elisa, quien aprende a cuidarlo. title: El CEO y la campesina
description:
Avery Rogers está pasando por muy mal momento: perdió a su padre, su novio la engañó con su hermana y un CEO despiadado puso su granja en la mira, pero esta aguerrida vaquerita de pueblo se lanza a un enfrentamiento donde vuelan las chispas contra Tyler Sinclair, el heredero corporativo enviado para tomar sus tierras. 
El deseo y la lealtad colisionan cuando en una parrillada de pueblo (el intento de Tyler de salvar a Avery y el legado de su padre) los enemigos se convierten en algo extremadamente cercano a amantes y sus mundos se ponen patas arriba.
Al principio, Avery utiliza a Tyler para vengarse de su exnovio, pero no sabes cuales son las verdaderas intenciones de Tyler. ¿Podrá Tyler cumplir su trabajo o será su amor más fuerte que su deber?

title: Hija de Fuego y Destino
description: Zhao Cuiping se lastima mientras trabaja para pagar la educación de su hija, Jin Feng. Cuando Jin Zhigang busca fondos para el tratamiento, Jin Feng recibe su aceptación universitaria. Jin Yan ayuda, y al partir, las mujeres del pueblo depositan sus esperanzas en Jin Feng. Ocho años después, Jin Feng regresa durante el funeral de su abuelo, donde las mujeres son excluidas del templo ancestral. Jin Feng retribuye al pueblo con dinero, decidida a luchar contra la opresión masculina. En el templo, descubre que Jin Yan podría ser su madre biológica, pero esta elige a su hermano, decepcionando a Jin Feng. Un asesino ataca, los aldeanos protegen a Jin Feng, quien salva al personal del laboratorio, solo para descubrir que el profesor es su padre biológico. ¿Qué destino le espera a Jin Feng?

title: Satán y su pequeña creyente
description: Poppy, de seis años, es una huérfana a la que todos acosan. Tras la muerte de sus padres, quienes murieron salvando a otros, vive sola en una choza en ruinas. En Nochebuena, accidentalmente envía su carta de deseos a Satán, porque “Santa” y “Satán” se parecen demasiado. Satán envía a su sabueso infernal de tres cabezas, Cerbero, para protegerla; disfrazado de cachorro, con dos cabezas removidas, un moño rojo atado al cuello y una amenaza resonando en sus oídos: cuida de mi pequeña creyente. Cerbero se convierte en “Pippy” para Poppy. Él ahuyenta a un vagabundo que irrumpe en su casa. Poppy descubre que puede oírlo hablar y se llena de alegría al saber que por fin tiene familia. Pero el acoso escolar no se detiene. Tyler le roba su abrigo nuevo y pisotea la manzana que ella guardó para Pippy. Satán viene a curarle las raspaduras, con el corazón doliéndole por la pequeña sin darse cuenta. Cuando la ve siendo acosada de nuevo, no lo soporta. Desciende en persona como una sombra negra gigante y hace volar a los niños crueles, y al hacerlo, rompe la ley del Infierno. Un rayo negro lo alcanza, dejándolo gravemente herido. Poppy parece sentir que alguien la salvó. Ella pala la nieve, recoge manzanas, arrastra a casa un pequeño y torcido árbol de Navidad, y graba un mensaje susurrado para el adulto que la protegió, enviándolo de vuelta con Cerbero. Solo en su gran salón, Satán presiona la muñeca grabadora una y otra vez, escuchando la voz de la niña, y siente que su corazón se ablanda. Entonces, la madre de Tyler denuncia a Poppy como huérfana, y el orfanato viene a llevársela. Ignorando sus heridas sin curar, Satán aparece como “Lucifer Morningstar” y adopta a Poppy como su hija. Dos corazones se acercan, cada uno salvando al otro. El día de Navidad, Poppy desea ver a sus padres una última vez. Lucifer asalta el Cielo, luchando contra los ángeles para traer sus almas de vuelta a ella.

title: Z Dead End
description: July 4th 2015 the world was invaded by zombies. Humanity was put to the test in a small town in Colorado, where it all began.

title: Z-Squad
description: Z-Squad chronicles the adventures of schoolgirls-turned-superheroes Chaney, Haemi, and Jeanie and their newfound, cuddly alien counterparts (Zoots) as they search for 144 enchanted crystals and save Earth and Z-Nation from a cast of bumbling baddies.

title: Kava z Kardamonom
description: Lviv, at the dawn of the nineteenth century. Young Anna is living a simple life, helping her uncle in the bakery, while her brother is in the seminary. Yet, Anna dreams of something much grander: true, mutual love. Her family has a different idea for her. She is supposed to marry the wealthy tradesman Marykan - and while he is in love with her, she cannot muster the same feelings for him. Then everything changes, when Count Adam Rodzinsky arrives to visit his sick uncle Witold. First, Anna is afraid of the older Adam. But then, she develops feelings for him, especially when they start to cross paths more and more frequently. Turns out, Adam was once married to a distant relative of Anna's, but the relationship ended in tragedy. Anna reminds him of his former beloved. Yet as their love blossoms, it remains forbidden.

title: Zdislava z Lemberka
description: One of the few historical films to come out of the Czech film industry in the nineties. It describes the last seven years in the life of Zdislava of Lemberk (Milena Steinmasslová), an early 13th century saint who sacrificed her life caring for the sick and implementing progressive methods of treatment.

title: Z Joke
description: The biogenetics genius Leonid has been researching a cure for cancer. Instead, he discovers a virus which threatens humanity with infertility. Being chased by the secret service, Leonid hides in the theatre run by his best friend Steven.

title: Z-Baw
description: In a far off galaxy where the gods forged five trophies honoring love, strength, wisdom, leadership and friendship, to bring balance to the universe. Zax and his evil Niurax Corporation plan to seize control of planet Mantar by stealing four of these trophies.

title: Malá z rybárny
description: Everyone's familiar with Hans Christian Andersen's The Little Mermaid, the story of a love capable of forgiving even the greatest betrayal. In Jan Balej's film - a work filled with wonderful animation, expressive puppet designs and an imaginative, shifting score from French composer Chapelier Fou - the fairy-tale romance is replaced with a bleak portrayal of life in a city harbor, yet its enduring message remains.

title: Z-ERO
description: Johnny Barnes, an otherwise average man trying to survive in a world being taken over by zombies, is infected by an Alfa female zombie. To his surprise, he discovers that he not only retains his cognitive abilities but has inherited special abilities too. He finds himself now on a mission to help rid the world of the cold-bodies and discover his full potential.

title: Dziewczeta z Nowolipek
description: Bronka, Franka, Amelka and Kwiryna are four girls living in the same poor district of Warsaw and going to the same school. They all fight for a better future but what the future brings is usually disappointment, sometimes even tragedy.

title: Pozegnanie z diablem
description: A young journalist tries to solve the mystery behind a murder in a small town.

title: Poslední z Aporveru
description: A fantasy story about a boy and girl who save the wold of Aporver by their love.

title: Plan Z
description: One man has a plan for a zombie outbreak, when one occurs it will take all his will to stick to it and all of his courage to change it.

title: Z pekla stestí
description: Once upon a time there was a farmer. His daughter Dora was mean, lazy and quarrelsome, but his stepdaughter Magareta was sweet, pretty and hardworking. So it happened that the servant Hannes fell in love with Magareta. When Hannes asks the farmer for Magareta's hand, the jealous Dora is disappointed. In revenge, she hands Hannes over to the king's soldier recruiters and drives Magareta out of the house. Hannes saves himself to two devilish journeymen, who equip him with some magical things for his further way. The and new strong friends help Hannes to save his Magareta and at the same time free the people from a tyrannical king.

title: The Z-Suite
description: Generations clash when the award-winning C-suite at Atelier ad agency is canceled and pushed out and the Gen Z social media team is put in charge.

title: Hrad z pisku
description: A mother and her daughter live alone far from human habitation. They are happy. Their harmonious relationship is interrupted by the unexpected arrival of a foreigner with his interpreter. In spite of the lack of verbal communication, the mother and the stranger fall in love, the daughter accepts him as well. The budding relationship is disturbed by the interpreter who realizes her power.

title: Pojdi z mano
description: In search of the best photo for the school competition, four teenagers head to remote hills. The competition for awards turns into a struggle for survival. Manc, who leads the group to remote but scenic countryside, where he spent his childhood with his grandpa, had been accused of stealing a phone and consequently might be expelled from school. Schoolmates Mina, Oto and Spurc join him on this trip. Mina, who is spoiled, stubborn city girl, breaks first in this foreign environment, but luckily by her side always stands Oto, rational boy who is in love with her. In this untouched nature which is such an unknown world to them also Spurc, who was golden-spoon-fed all his life, turns into a cowardish spoiled-child, and at the end Manc is again the one who safely guides them back home. A story about growing up, love, friendship and heroism. The warm but suspenseful and occasionally spine-chilling film focuses on what happens in the today's world when technology stops working and the 'primal' human instincts come to light.

title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero [Hindi]
description: Aryabhatt ka zero is a heartwarming slice of life drama that celebrates the power of self-belief through its core philosophy—"Believe in Yourself." The film follows the journey of Brahamgupta Shrivastava, affectionately known as Baggu, a 25-year-old directionless young man from a middle-class family. Dismissed as a failure by society and burdened by self-doubt, Baggu struggles to find purpose in a world that constantly underestimates him. As life throws one challenge after another at him and his family, Baggu embarks on an unexpected journey of resilience, hope, and self-discovery. With unwavering support from his loved ones and the courage to believe in himself, he gradually transforms from an overlooked nobody into an inspiring hero. Packed with humor, emotion, and relatable moments, AKZ is an uplifting story of ordinary people fighting extraordinary battles. It reminds us that every "zero" has the potential to become a hero when they choose to believe in themselves.

title: The Labyrinth of Grisaia: The Cocoon of Caprice 0
description: Having attended Mihama Academy for about a year, Yuuji Kazami has seemingly found his place within the school, but he suddenly decides to pursue a promotion in CIRS. After consulting JB about his intentions, they both thoroughly examine Yuuji's documents and dissect the events of his upbringing to determine if the job is fit for him. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the two, the girls of Mihama uncover some torn documents in Yuuji's room. After restoring the papers, they discover the story that has formed, or perhaps broken, Yuuji into the man he is today. However, what was thought to be history has haunted him to the present, and the chains of the past begin to drag him back into the darkness.

title: Kamitsukitai/Dorakiyura yori ai-0
description: A loyal employee of a pharmaceutical company finds himself in intensive care after a critical injury, and is accidentally given a transfusion of Count Dracula's blood.

title: Twelve Nights 2: Back to Day Zero
Deep Throat - 1972: The Year Zero of Pornography
description: At a time when the United States was reeling from the shockwaves of the sexual revolution, the lifting of censorship and the liberation of morals brought pornographic cinema out of the shadows: the industry sought to reach a wider audience and gain respectability. In 1972, "Deep Throat" (Gorge profonde), a film cobbled together at breakneck speed by Gerard Damiano, a ladies' hairdresser with a passion for cinema, was released nationwide and immediately became a resounding social phenomenon, making its debutante lead actress, Linda Lovelace, the first X-rated superstar. But while this explicit and kitschy film helped to lift many taboos about sexuality, its behind-the-scenes story is far from glamorous.

title: Port Charles
description: Spin-off of "General Hospital" focusing on the professional and personal lives of the first year interns at Port Charles' General Hospital. Now residents at the hospital, the doctors and their friends and families are constantly threatened by Dr. Greg Cooper who may or may not be the General Homicide killer. Cooper tries to get revenge on all of them because he was dropped from the hospital's intern program.

title: Will to Power
description: The film "Will to Power" is the story of redemption and two best friends (Jason and Erik) who end up planning a murder that goes anything but right. Kathryn is the 'innocent' target of the murder plan and in the end Jason proves to be one of the darkest characters in the film and represents the underlying theme to never underestimate anyone.

title: Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1
description: A labourer rises through ranks of a smuggling syndicate, infuriating some powerful forces in the process.

An unmarried actress in Munich becomes pregnant but decides against marrying the child's father, and eventually moves in with a more agreeable man she meets on a winter sports holiday.

title: Radiant [Hindi] S1-S2
description: Synopsis Seth is an aspiring sorcerer from the Pompo Hills area. Like all wizards, he is an "infected," one of the few living beings who survived the contact of the Nemesis--creatures fallen from the sky that contaminate and decimate all those they touch. Being immune to them, Seth wants to become a Hunter and fight the Nemesis. But more than that, Seth wants to engage in a quest that goes beyond the simple hunt for monsters. He wants to find the Radiant, their presumed cradle. Aided by a faction of fellow sorcerers, he travels the world in search of the Radiant, under the harsh scrutiny of the Inquisition. (Source: MangaHelpers, edited) Background Radiant is based on the french Comic of the same name.

title: 4 Elements
description: Rose returns from America when her stepfather's accident puts her in danger from Wasu, who wants her land. Her friend Din offers protection through marriage. Their fake union slowly stirs genuine emotions.

title: 4pm
description: Jahid, a former Iraqi special forces commando haunted by his past, seeks redemption after leaving the military. His life changes when he meets a young German teenager and rape survivor working to reclaim her sense of safety and self-worth.

title: 4 Minutes
description: Great, the son of a wealthy business owner, can suddenly foresee 4 minutes into the future. The power leads him to experience strange events, including his encounter with the resident doctor, Tyme.

title: 4 Ever
description: Young musicians Andy, Ian, Ciro, and Darío meet by chance at a restaurant, where they get involved in an unexpected situation: A valuable guitar has just disappeared. To recover the guitar and return it to its owner, they must put together a band.

title: 4 Idiots
description: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys." Their dream of a quick fortune has turned into a nightmare of survival. Now, they have only one choice: outsmart Pulibaba or become the next victims of his dark business. A twisted game of greed, betrayal, and survival is about to unfold.
